description: Land Acquisition - Compensations for the acquisition of the Land in Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices about specific land parcels being acquired by the state, including property descriptions (lot numbers, land names, extents), compensation amounts, and legal deposit information. The content focuses solely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other administrative matters that would fall under other categories.
